response.sql:
WITH group_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.arcref AS project_reference,
    p.fundflux AS funding_source,
    SUM(s.gbsize) / SUM(s.spanmin) AS rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN projects AS p
    ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate
  FROM group_rates
)
SELECT
  g.project_reference,
  g.funding_source,
  g.rate,
  g.rate - b.average_rate AS excess
FROM group_rates AS g
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE g.rate > b.average_rate
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A group's rate is the ratio of the sum of its file sizes to the sum of its durations; SQLite's AVG then gives each group rate equal weight in the benchmark. Groups with a zero or NULL total duration produce a NULL rate and are excluded from the benchmark and results.
